The child is holding a white bubble wand with a green ring in their right hand (wrapped in a white glove/sleeve). A large, iridescent bubble is forming at the wand and near the child's mouth. Several other out-of-focus bubbles float in the background against a dimly lit interior wall. The image has a distinct vintage digital camera aesthetic with visible noise and flash reflection.
